name: process_step_tag
label: Tagging Table for Process Steps
description: Tagging table for workflow steps, used for related queries and report scenarios in process-related scenarios.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: process_step_uuid
fields.description: The unique identifier for the step, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: Tag_id, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_step_uuid, tag_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_process_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the process_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_tag_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the tag_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
